blocks.heading: Beginner FAQ
blocks.summary: 6 short questions and answers on the login and the account.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of 6 items in the form "- **Question?** Answer." (bold question, then a one-sentence answer); bold is required here for the question text only. Questions, in this order: (1) which details registration asks for (e-mail, password, legal name, date of birth, residential address); (2) how to log in (with the registered e-mail and password, as the page explains); (3) whether a player may hold more than one account (no: one personal account per player); (4) when the welcome bonus can be claimed (after registration, on the first qualifying deposit of at least €50); (5) whether a player can log in from a phone (yes, in the browser of a smartphone or tablet; a home-screen shortcut is possible); (6) which currencies an account can use (EUR, USD, MYR, THB, SGD and USDT). Answers repeat the facts of the sections of the page in other words and add nothing new. Do not answer questions about multiple devices, lockouts or login limits: no data.
